events.text:
I have fixed the pagination logic in `paginate.py`.

### Root Cause
1. `start` was computed as `page * per_page` instead of `(page - 1) * per_page`, causing 1-indexed pages to skip the first page and slice starting from the second page or beyond.
2. `total_pages` was calculated using integer division (`len(items) // per_page`), which incorrectly rounded down when there were remaining items on a partial last page (e.g. 25 items with 10 per page resulted in 2 pages instead of 3).

### Fix
- Updated `start` index calculation to `(page - 1) * per_page`.
- Updated `total_pages` calculation to ceiling division (`math.ceil(len(items) / per_page)`), handling empty lists correctly.

### Files Changed
- `paginate.py`
